Apache ECharts
==============

File:     echarts.min.js
Version:  5.6.1
Upstream: https://registry.npmjs.org/echarts/-/echarts-5.6.1.tgz  (dist/echarts.min.js)
Project:  https://github.com/apache/echarts
Licence:  Apache-2.0
Fetched:  2026-08-25

Local changes: none. Byte-identical to the published dist file.

Licence text: LICENSE beside this file is the canonical Apache-2.0 text,
included because redistributing an Apache-2.0 work means shipping a copy of
the licence with it, not only a URL. The minified file carries the ASF header
banner of its own. Upstream's NOTICE file is NOT vendored here — fetch it from
the project repository above if you need it.

Why vendored rather than loaded from a CDN
------------------------------------------
A rendered report must open from disk, offline, years later — a CDN
reference makes the file expire silently. Tree-shaking to a smaller
custom build was considered and rejected: it requires a JavaScript
bundler in the toolchain, and the skill's only dependency is uv.

The cost is ~1 MB per report. That is the price of a file that still
works when nothing else does.
